net sales.heading: Net Sales
net sales.text: Our sales for the three months ended September 30, 2026 were $1,218.8 million, an increase of 3% compared to $1,186.1 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to an increase in sales of Gaming, Video Collaboration and Keyboards & Combos, offset by a decrease in sales of Tablet Accessories. Our sales for the six months ended September 30, 2026 were $2,446.1 million, an increase of 5% compared to $2,333.8 million for the six months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to an increase in sales of Gaming, Pointing Devices and Video Collaboration, offset by a decrease in sales of Tablet Accessories. Our sales for both the three- and six-month periods benefited from favorable changes in foreign currency exchange rates. If currency exchange rates had been constant in the three and six months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, our sales growth rates in constant currency would have been 2% and 4%, respectively.

Gaming.heading: Gaming
Gaming.text:
Our Gaming category includes PC gaming (mice, headsets, keyboards), steering wheels, console gaming headsets, microphones and Streamlabs services.

Sales of Gaming increased 8% and 10% for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the three and six months ended September 30, 2025, respectively, primarily driven by an increase in sales of PC gaming mice, particularly PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE launched in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026, partially offset by a decline in sales of PC gaming headsets. The increase in sales of Gaming for the six-month period was also driven by an increase in sales of steering wheels .

Keyboards\u00a0& Combos.heading: Keyboards & Combos
Keyboards\u00a0& Combos.text:
Our Keyboards & Combos category includes PC keyboards and keyboard/mice combo products.

Sales of Keyboards & Combo s increased 4% and 3% for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the three and six months ended September 30, 2025, respectively, primarily driven by an increase in sales of wireless keyboards and wireless combo products, partially offset by a decrease in sales of wired keyboards. The increase in sales for both the three- and six-month periods was primarily driven by an increase in sales in the Americas region, partially offset by a decrease in sales in the EMEA and Asia Pacific regions.

Pointing Devices.heading: Pointing Devices
Pointing Devices.text:
Our Pointing Devices category includes PC- and Mac-related mice including trackballs, and presentation tools.

Sales of Pointing Devices increased 4% and 10% for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the three and six months ended September 30, 2025, respectively, primarily driven by an increase in sales of wireless mice, particularly MX Master 4 launched in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026. A continued mix shift to premium products in our portfolio contributed to sales growth in this category. The increase in sales for both the three- and six-month periods was primarily driven by an increase in sales in the Americas and Asia Pacific regions, partially offset by a decrease in sales in EMEA.

Video Collaboration.heading: Video Collaboration
Video Collaboration.text:
Our Video Collaboration category includes Logitech’s conference room cameras, which combine affordable enterprise-quality audio and high definition 4K video to bring video conferencing to a variety of room sizes.

Sales of Video Collaboration increased 12% for each of the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the three and six months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to an increase in sales of conference room cameras across all three regions reflecting a refresh of video conferencing equipment installed during the pandemic.

Webcams.heading: Webcams
Webcams.text:
Our Webcams category includes webcams and streaming cameras. Our webcams turn any desktop into an instant collaboration space.

Sales of Webcams decreased 9% for each of the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the three and six months ended September 30, 2025, primarily due to a decrease in sales in the EMEA and Asia Pacific regions reflecting a global market decline in Webcams.

Tablet Accessories.heading: Tablet Accessories
Tablet Accessories.text:
Our Tablet Accessories category primarily includes tablet keyboards.

Sales of Tablet Accessories decreased 32% and 16% for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the three and six months ended September 30, 2025, respectively, primarily due to a decrease in sales in the Asia Pacific and Americas regions. The decline in Asia Pacific was primarily due to a large education deal in the prior year while the decrease in the Americas was mainly driven by a decline in the Tablets market in the region.

Other.heading: Other
Other.text:
Our Other category primarily consists of mobile speakers and PC speakers.

Sales in Other categor y decreased 6% for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025, primarily driven by a decrease in sales of PC and mobile speakers. Sales in Other categor y decreased 9% for the six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to the six months ended September 30, 2025, primarily driven by a decrease in sales of mobile speakers.

During fiscal year 2026, Keyboards & Combos sales increased 6%, comp ared to fiscal year 2025, primarily driven by an increase in sales of our cordless combo products.

Pointing Devices.heading: Pointing Devices
Pointing Devices.text:
Our Pointing Devices category includes PC- and Mac-related mice including trackballs, and presentation tools.

During fiscal year 2026, Pointing Devices sale s increased 9%, compared to fiscal year 2025, primarily driven by an increase in sales of cordless mice.

Video Collaboration.heading: Video Collaboration
Video Collaboration.text:
Our Video Collaboration category includes Logitech’s conference room cameras, which combine affordable enterprise-quality audio and high definition 4K video to bring video conferencing to a variety of room sizes.

During fiscal year 2026, Video Collaboration sales increased 10%, compared to fiscal year 2025, primarily due to an increase in sales of conference room cameras.

Webcams.heading: Webcams
Webcams.text:
Our Webcams category includes webcams and streaming cameras. Our webcams turn any desktop into an instant collaboration space.

During fiscal year 2026, Webcams sales increased 3%, compared to fiscal year 2025, primarily driven by an increase in sales in our Americas and EMEA regions, partially offset by declining sales in the Asia Pacific region.

Tablet Accessories.heading: Tablet Accessories
Tablet Accessories.text:
Our Tablet Accessories category primarily includes tablet keyboards.

During fiscal year 2026, Tablet Accessories sal es increased 12%, compared to fiscal year 2025, primarily benefiting from strong sales from the education sector, particularly in our Asia Pacific region.

Other.heading: Other
Other.text:
Our Other category primarily consists of mobile speakers and PC speakers.

During fiscal year 2026, Other sales decreased 20% c ompared to 2025 , primarily driven by a decrease in sales of mobile speakers.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Long-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for their return: financial. A stake in another business that is part of operations is operating.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Income taxes payable, non-current
lines.why: Taxes on operating income due after a year (often uncertain tax positions): operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
